lines.speaker: maya
lines.text: three days of being brave, and these tacos were worth every cent. which was not many cents. the trip fund approves

lines.speaker: roxy
lines.text: zero dairy, zero regrets. new favorite stall!!

lines.speaker: brooke
lines.text: fresh, light, and i'm going to sleep like a baby. roxy, your market is a keeper

lines.speaker: maya
lines.text: THREE dollar signs. for TACOS. i'm going home to eat toast in the dark. tell the coast i tried

lines.speaker: liam
lines.text: maya, come back, there are like fifty other stalls!! ...she's already on the bus

lines.speaker: brooke
lines.text: i saw that price board and my jaw dropped. we're going after her, everybody grab a napkin

lines.speaker: maya
lines.text: really good tacos. also two dollar signs. the trip fund just flinched

lines.speaker: liam
lines.text: i'll split my last taco with you. trip fund rescue mission

lines.speaker: roxy
lines.text: the tacos were amazing, but every single one came buried in cheese and crema. my stomach would like a word

lines.speaker: liam
lines.text: i scraped mine off in solidarity. too late for yours though. sorry roxy

lines.speaker: brooke
lines.text: so tasty, but so heavy. i'm going to bed with a brick in my stomach. so much for a light night

lines.speaker: maya
lines.text: heavy, but cheap! brooke, walk it off with me. the market's huge

lines.speaker: maya
lines.text: dim sum?? it's delicious, but i held out for tacos for THREE DAYS

lines.speaker: liam
lines.text: the dumplings were great though. tacos tomorrow, maya. i promise
